title.zh: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision
title.en: Vitalik Buterin maps Ethereum’s shift beyond a blockchain in sweeping 2030 vision

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin published a 2030 vision for Ethereum in which off-chain computation and cryptographic proofs replace universal re-execution, enabling more throughput and better privacy after the planned Hegotá upgrade.
